title: Stop paying for AI! How to use N2 Brain in Hermes Agent for free.
description:
Ditch the expensive, rigid AI setups of the past. By integrating NexAgi's N2 Pro model directly into Hermes Agent, users gain access to a powerful, next-gen reasoning brain without the hefty price tag. This approach eliminates the constant need to re-explain context or rewire workflows when new models emerge. By utilizing distinct profiles with persistent memory that automatically logs conversations into Obsidian, agents become smarter, more cohesive, and infinitely easier to manage.
#AItools #HermesAgent #NexAgi #OpenRouter #AIAutomation #ProductivityHacks
